pick_of_the_day.thesis: The Codex vs Claude Code skill philosophy split isn't a feature debate — it's two competing theories of how agents should accumulate expertise, and whichever wins will define the next generation of developer tools.

model_literacy.relevance: OpenAI's 10x agent speed-up comes from warm container reuse — understanding the cold-start bottleneck explains why agentic workflows felt sluggish and what changed.

items.title: OpenAI Cuts Agent Container Spin-Up Time by 10x with Warm Pooling

items.key_fact: 10x faster container spin-up for skills, shell, and code interpreter
